'''Eawen Vrill''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] and the sister of [[Eaden Vrill]]. Like her brother, Eawen was also a member of [[Sälãi Käsi]], a [[Teräs Käsi/Legends|Teräs Käsi]] religious order. As of [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]] she was one of the two surviving members of this order.<ref name="SG" />
